chunks: Warn those who fear that they will be gathered before their Lord, and they will have no protector or intercessor apart from Him, so that they may become righteous.
ai.seo_question: Who are the people warned about having no intercessor on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Tawhid* in authority, highlighting that while intercession (*Shafa'ah*) exists, it is solely by God's permission and not an independent right of the prophets or angels. It serves as a reminder to the faithful that ultimate accountability lies with Allah, reinforcing the necessity of *Taqwa* as the sole criterion for salvation on the Day of Gathering.
